title: κ = 7.92580093369946e-4: w3 cube layer on #325's p10b word with a stronger p = 10 complex supplier
body:
**Conditional κ = 396290046684973/(5·10¹⁷) ≈ 7.92580093369946e-4** (+3.71 % over #315, +1.97 % over #332/#333). The complex supplier binds; the bit root is 1.07 % above its leaf cap.

## What this adds

- **Bit side:** PR #310's w3 Design T and twin condensation, ported to h = 20 and applied to PR #325's p10b word (exported unchanged from #325's own pipeline; the export reproduces #325's bit root exactly). Design T frees 480 helpers and needs no new frames; twin condensation adds 320 line frames. Bit root 7.70277e-4 → 8.01726e-4.
- **Complex side:** a p = 10 gcert/1 program built with #304's recipe on #325's re-annealed pair module, #327's p = 10 triple module and #315's all-but-one module (flow R 6,265). b = 396604388013523/(5·10¹⁷), against 7795/10⁷ for #327's p = 10 program.
- **#315's complex checks ported to p = 10**, with the five p = 11 pins derived from the certificate or re-pinned.

## Checks (`bash research/w3-p10b-complex-p10/verify.sh <fresh dir>`, ~5 min)

Manifest; rebuild of the final word from the vendored base (both hashes); ported Design T verifier (legality, all F₂ columns, nondegeneracy); #266's official legality and five-stage columns checkers (11,940 columns, bridge controls); exact nondegeneracy and #315's prime-witness rule on the new frames; exact width-100 bank tiling; Sussman's gx.check1 + gxcore, labels, scalar words, splice controls and precision guard on the complex program; both rational moment engines with the 10⁻¹⁶ fallback; #315's outer assembly on the complex-bound path (47 strict constraints, cap rejected, adjacent κ rejected). PR #200's complete complex checker and PR #194's contract were also run on the complex program (receipts in `receipts/`).

## Open obligations

#310's native downstream chain (bank review with charts, changed projector charts, geometry admission, finite invoice) is not ported to p = 10; only bank feasibility is shown. #315's own scalar/prime/finite stages cannot take an edited word. The complex guard keeps #315's p = 11 additive row constants. All inherited interfaces remain assumptions; this is a conditional finite construction, not a formal verification.

## Credits and AI disclosure

Builds on #325/#315 (DreamingOfClouds), #310 (utcorvusvolat-dotcom's w3 work), #266's checkers, #327's triple module and the #304/#256/#233/#202/#200/#194/#184 complex lineage with Sussman's checker; see `NOTICE.md`. Prepared with substantial Anthropic Claude assistance.
